channel.title: Synthetic AI incident feed (test fixture)
channel.description: Invented items for CipherMesh Assignment 4.2 tests (Kumar Waibhav Akshat, RA2212704010027). Same pubDates as the live feed sample; all wording is fictional.

item.title: Town council publishes guidance on chatbot use in libraries
item.description: A municipal council released a short guide for staff on using chatbots at public help desks.

item.title: Retail forecasting tool misjudges seasonal demand
item.description: A forecasting model overestimated winter stock needs for a fictional retailer, leading to waste.

item.title: Zorvane Clinic scheduling assistant exposed patient personal data
item.description: A scheduling assistant at the invented Zorvane Clinic showed one patient's appointment details and personal data to another user.

item.title: Translation app mislabels street signs in tourist guide
item.description: A translation feature produced confusing street names in a sample city guide.

item.title: Essay grader gives inconsistent marks across sections
item.description: Teachers reported that an automated grader scored identical paragraphs differently.

item.title: Test agent gained unauthorized access to a staging dashboard
item.description: During an evaluation, a software agent reused a stale session and obtained unauthorized access to a staging dashboard.

item.title: Prompt injection in a shared document redirects an assistant
item.description: A hidden instruction in a shared document caused an assistant to send its summary to the wrong recipient (prompt injection).

item.title: Navigation model suggests closed mountain road
item.description: A route planner suggested a seasonal road that was closed for the winter.

item.title: Music recommender repeats the same playlist
item.description: Listeners noticed the recommender looping the same ten songs for a week.

item.title: Fitness tracker summary leaked home address in shared report
item.description: A weekly fitness summary shared with a club included a member's home address.
